settings.libs.title: Libraries loaded here; the search starts from the right-click on an MS2 spectrum (HR part).
settings.cen.ask: Confirmation before creating the one-point-per-peak copies; {n} = number of files, {size} = maximum space, already formatted (e.g. 120 MB).
settings.cen.run: Progress of the reduction: {n} = file in progress, {m} = total files, {name} = file name.
export.done: Outcome of the data export: {name} = name of the downloaded file, {n} = number of files in the archive (manifest included).
import.ls: Restore preview: {n} = settings entries in the file, {m} = how many differ from the current value.
import.idb: Restore preview: {store} = name of the store (notebook, lists, molecules...), {n} = number of records in the file.
import.lib: Restore preview: {n} = number of library files in the file.
import.partial: Outcome of the restore: {n} = library files not written because they are in use.
settings.cen.done: End of the reduction; {n} = copies created.
settings.cen.stopped: Reduction cancelled by the user; {n} = copies already created.
settings.cen.fail: Error on a file of the reduction; {name} = file name.
settings.mem.status: Status line of the memory budget in the settings; {mb} = budget in MB, {scans} = approximate maximum scans, {reason} = reason for the choice, {conf} = reliability.
settings.mem.inputs: Machine data used to choose the budget; {gb} = device memory in GB, {cores} = logical cores, {hard} = hard limit in MB.
